# VPS-SH (Linux Host Management & Docker Application Engine)

> Single-file Linux operations console and Docker lifecycle management engine for Debian 12+ and Ubuntu 22.04+.
> Native bash execution, zero background daemon, deterministic non-interactive CLI primitives.

## Quick Installation & Direct Run

```bash
# Execute remotely or bootstrap installation (registers 'vs' command):
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/666OS/vps-sh/main/vps.sh | bash
```

## AI Agent Integration & Machine Snapshot

- `vs ai`: Generates a high-density, token-optimized system diagnosis snapshot and command manifest (~250 tokens).
- `vs ai --json`: Outputs minified, single-line JSON (`schema: 1`, additive evolution) of the live system state (OS, CPU, memory, swap, disk, outbound IP, SSH policy, authorized-key presence vs readiness (`has_keys` = any valid key file exists; `key_login_ready` = an SSH-loginable root/sudo account holds a valid key, which gates `sec_lock_pwd`; `root_key`, `sudo_key`) & `sudoers`, fail2ban, firewall install/conflict/policy/open ports, Docker status, and installed app items with numeric/`null` `port`, `host`, `ports`, and `status` (`running`|`partial`|`error`|`stopped`|`unknown`)).

## CLI Operations Manual (Deterministic Primitives)

All commands are non-interactive (except sec_gen_key, which is TTY-only), idempotent, and exit with status 0 on success.

### 1. System Operations (`sys_*`)
- `vs sys_swap <mb>`: Create or resize swap memory (e.g. `vs sys_swap 2048`).
- `vs sys_swap_off`: Disable and delete swap file.
- `vs sys_tune`: Enable BBR congestion control and kernel network/file performance tuning.
- `vs sys_clean [--aggressive]`: Standardize journald quota (200M / 2 weeks), safely prune caches and non-security logs.
- `vs sys_update`: Upgrade system packages non-interactively.
- `vs sys_tz <timezone>`: Set system timezone (default: `Asia/Shanghai`).

### 2. Network Diagnostics (`net_*`)
- `vs net_dns_foreign`: Configure foreign public DNS (Cloudflare / Google 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8).
- `vs net_dns_china`: Configure domestic public DNS (Aliyun / DNSPod 223.5.5.5, 119.29.29.29).
- `vs net_prio_v4`: Prioritize IPv4 for outbound traffic.
- `vs net_prio_v6`: Prioritize IPv6 for outbound traffic.
- `vs net_test`: Run return routing diagnostic to major telecom networks.

### 3. Security & SSH Hardening (`sec_*`)
- `vs sec_port <port>`: Change SSH port, test configuration with `sshd -t` before reload, and auto-sync firewall.
- `vs sec_lock_pwd`: Disable password authentication (SSH key-only).
- `vs sec_unlock_pwd`: Enable password authentication.
- `vs sec_lock_root`: Disable root login completely (requires an existing sudo user with authorized key).
- `vs sec_root_keyonly`: Restrict root login to SSH key only (prohibits password authentication for root).
- `vs sec_unlock_root`: Permit root login (allows password and key).
- `vs sec_root_login <no|prohibit-password|yes>`: Explicitly configure root SSH login policy.
- `vs sec_key <key_or_url> [user]`: Import SSH public key idempotently (checks for duplicates).
- `vs sec_clean_key [user]`: Scan and purge legacy on-disk private keys (`id_ed25519_vps`) from server.
- `vs sec_passwd <user> <password>`: Update user password non-interactively.

### 4. Native Firewall Management (`fw_*`)
- `vs fw_open <port...>`: Allow inbound TCP/UDP ports through `VPS-IN` and `VPS-DOCKER` chains (IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack, controls host and Docker published ports).
- `vs fw_close <port...>`: Close previously opened ports (SSH protection port is permanently guarded).
- `vs fw_open_all`: Switch to Blacklist Mode (`INPUT ACCEPT`, default pass).
- `vs fw_close_all`: Switch to Whitelist Mode (`INPUT DROP` & `VPS-DOCKER DROP`, default block for both host and Docker published ports).
- `vs fw_apply`: Atomically compile and apply firewall state from `/etc/vps-sh/fw.conf` via `iptables-restore --noflush`.
- `vs fw_ban_ip <ip...>`: Add IP or CIDR to `vps_blacklist` ipset (blocks host and containers).
- `vs fw_allow_ip <ip...>`: Add IP or CIDR to `vps_whitelist` ipset.
- `vs fw_unban_ip <ip...>`: Remove IP or CIDR from firewall sets.
- `vs fw_ping [on|off|toggle]`: Enable or disable ICMP echo replies.
- `vs fw_ddos [on|off|toggle]`: Enable SYN flood rate limiting against DDoS (drops floods without port bypass).
- `vs fw_reset`: Safely reset firewall rules to baseline (host-level opened ports are cleared; only running Docker/app ports retained).

### 5. Docker & Container Lifecycle (`docker_*`)
- `vs docker_install`: Install Docker Engine and Docker Compose plugin.
- `vs docker_cleanup`: Prune stopped containers, dangling images, and build caches.
- `vs docker_mirror_fast`: Apply verified domestic/fast Docker registry mirrors.

### 6. Application Market (`app_*`)
- `vs app_install <id> [port] [host]`: Deploy application from market template (e.g. `vs app_install npm 81`) and auto-open all published compose ports when bound to `0.0.0.0`.
- `vs app_port <id> <port>`: Change application host port, recreate container, and atomically sync firewall ports (auto-rolls back on Compose failure).
- `vs app_host <id> <0.0.0.0|127.0.0.1|toggle>`: Switch application bind address (`0.0.0.0` public or `127.0.0.1` local proxy), recreate container, and atomically sync firewall ports.
- `vs app_update <id>`: Pull latest image and recreate application container.
- `vs app_restart <id>`: Restart application container.
- `vs app_stop <id>`: Stop application container.
- `vs app_start <id>`: Start application container.
- `vs app_logs <id>`: View live logs of application.
- `vs app_uninstall <id> [purge_data:0|1]`: Down container, cleanly close unused firewall ports, and optionally purge data directory (`/opt/vps-sh/apps/<id>`).
- Application Catalog Index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/666OS/vps-apps/main/llms.txt

### 7. Operations & Scheduling (`ops_*`)
- `vs ops_cron_clear`: Remove all user crontab entries non-interactively.

## Safety Assertions & Guardrails
- **Dual-Stack Firewall**: Inbound firewall rules synchronize across `iptables` (IPv4) and `ip6tables` (IPv6).
- **Docker Port Whitelist Enforcement**: Under whitelist mode, Docker published ports (DNAT via FORWARD) are strictly filtered via `VPS-DOCKER` on `DOCKER-USER`. New published ports require `vs fw_open <port>` to be exposed externally.
- **Container Network Isolation**: Docker bridge traffic routes through `FORWARD`; binding to `127.0.0.1` ensures true local-only isolation for reverse proxies.
- **SSH Lockout Immunity**: SSH port is guarded in hardware logic; `fw_close` explicitly rejects closing SSH port. On Ubuntu 22.10+, handles `ssh.socket` listen streams.
- **Private Key Seclusion**: `sec_gen_key` is strictly interactive-only and forbidden in non-interactive/AI agent environments to prevent leaking private keys into logs or token contexts. Generated private keys exist only in RAM and are wiped immediately upon confirmation; servers never persist private keys.
- **Fail-Safe Rollback**: `sec_ssh_apply` validates config syntax with `sshd -t` before restarting daemon; auto-reverts on failure.
- **Non-blocking Execution**: CLI subcommands never call interactive `read` prompts; invalid arguments immediately fail fast. Unattended updates and uninstalls use `-y` (`vs up -y`, `vs rm -y`).
